old_value: {"id":"jmap-chat-spec-xpzz.3","title":"vtc-00: per-viewer playback authorisation","description":"Viewers fetch a short-lived playback credential (signed URL or token) from the server instead of a static URL; define how a viewer obtains it (method or server-set per-viewer property), its expiry, and the hook where a paid gate ticket (payments extension) converts to a playback credential.","status":"open","priority":3,"issue_type":"task","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-10-21T21:34:12.836278233Z","created_by":"agent","updated_at":"2026-10-21T21:34:12.836278233Z","dependencies":[{"issue_id":"jmap-chat-spec-xpzz.3","depends_on_id":"jmap-chat-spec-xpzz","type":"parent-child","created_at":"2026-10-21T21:34:13.675339446Z","created_by":"agent","metadata":"{}"}]}
new_value: {"description":"Viewers obtain a short-lived playback credential from the server instead of relying on a static URL: an opaque string with an expiry, obtained via a method or a per-viewer server-set property. How it is presented (query parameter, bearer token, cookie) is per protocol and out of scope; the spec only says a viewer presents it to the playback endpoint. Hook point for a paid gate ticket (payments extension) turning into a playback credential."}
